consumerRules: Vertical adapters may translate field names and calculate vertical-specific organic score signals.
Vertical adapters must not redefine confirmation, freshness, MUST/PREFER/IGNORE, safety or sponsorship semantics.
Vendored runtime copies are generated artifacts and must match the pinned core checksum.
Unknown or stale evidence may never become a confirmed positive or negative MUST result.
Confirmed partial or temporarily_unavailable does not satisfy a default MUST=yes requirement.
Commercial placement may decorate organic results but may not change organic score or rank.
